_comment: Render sweep on the jscad modeling engine (sci push jscadui/render-jscad), 320s hang guard. 59 models draw nothing and score empty, the 45 the manifold sweep also scores empty plus ones this engine returns nothing for. 25 of the 28 errors extrude a geom2 whose sides do not close, random_city.scad and random_city_taiwan.scad among them now that comparison-only skips render; see docs/backlog.md. packing_circles.scad sits on the time limit and has gone both ways across runs, so it is marked flaky.
